item.title: How AI Built This at Figma
item.description:
Last Thursday evening I went to How AI Built This at Figma’s new London office, run with Inara Talent and Women in Tech UK. The London team owns Figma’s MCP server and the journey between design and code, and three of their engineers gave talks about how they work.

Taking the human out of the loop

Emil Culic talked about how a small team built the Figma app for ChatGPT and Codex with OpenAI. The timeline was very aggressive: the first intro call was at the start of September and it was announced at the end of September, and OpenAI were still building the SDK they were building on top of while they did it.
